method: Prototype only, original octree/Plummer/traversal arithmetic. Persistent worker_threads, shared Float64 state and read-only published tree, atomic target queue in chunks of 256, barrier before final kick. Original serial KDK and prototype both perform four complete steps from identical copied initial arrays; first step is warmup, following three steps timed. No changes to physical parameters.

transfers.note: Node worker_threads round trip; cloned back vs transferred both ways. Not a GPU readback or a browser main-thread rendering cost.
